title: CamStack addon generator
description: Scaffold a new CamStack addon workspace package.

name.description: Addon name (without scope). Used as the folder name, the package name (under `@camstack/`), and the addon manifest id.
name.x-prompt: What name should the addon have? (e.g. `weather-station`)

directory.description: Parent directory the package is created in (default: packages).

description.description: Short marketing description for package.json + admin UI.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the admin UI.
